classification_rules: Award descriptions establish stated procurement purpose, not every operational use.
RELX Inc. and LexisNexis Risk Solutions Inc. remain separate legal-entity nodes.
Generic subscriptions are not classified as surveillance without additional evidence.
Amounts and transaction histories are timestamped snapshots.
data.method: Expand from the queued federal-contract target using USAspending award records, preserve exact recipient names, and classify stated purpose without inferring unstated operational use.
data.research_question: Which additional federal awards distinguish law-enforcement research, generic subscriptions, and identity-verification services, and which exact RELX legal entity is the reported recipient?
